subject: MAP sprint kickoff: hosting lanes, geo constraints, and contract gating
messages:
From: Sara Miles <sara@horizonhealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Kickoff: MAP & hosting question for Horizon POC

Jonas —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The leadership team at Horizon wants to move to a short MAP to lock down scope, timelines, and the hosting decision (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) before we commit to a PoC. High level constraints: PHI in production, US-only data residency, sub-100ms 95th latency SLAs for our clinical inference path, and a 2-month procurement window.

Can you put together a suggested MAP with an evaluation plan that covers security gating, performance checks, and pricing sketch for hosted/dedicated/private? We'd like the MAP to include clear owner assignments and a proposed close timeline.

I've attached a one-page RFP summary that captures our requirements (Horizon_RFP_summary.pdf). Procurement will be on the thread shortly.

—Sara
Sara Miles
VP Product, Horizon Health
attachments: Horizon_RFP_summary.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Sara Miles <sara@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-02T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & hosting question for Horizon POC

Sara —

Appreciate the clear constraints. Attaching a MAP template (jonas_MAP_template.xlsx) and a proposal for a 2-week discovery + 3-week eval cadence that exercises Hosted first (fastest path), trials Dedicated (reserved capacity) if latency/cost needs dictate, and assesses Private (VPC/on-prem) as a compliance fallback.

Proposed high-level timeline (draft):
- Week 0: MAP sign & procurement contact assigned
- Weeks 1–2: Discovery + security questionnaire + small baseline perf run on Hosted
- Weeks 3–5: Parallel evals: Hosted stress tests vs Dedicated baseline (quantized model)
- Week 6: Decision review & recommended path; if Private required, scope next steps

Key gating items: SOC 2 + infosec signoff, KMS integration for PHI, regional data residency confirmation, and a short sentinel test set for latency. Can you confirm procurement lead and any hard deadlines?

If that works I’ll circulate a filled MAP and owners.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
attachments: jonas_MAP_template.xlsx

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-03T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & hosting question for Horizon POC (internal recommendations)

All —

Quick internal note to propose what we actually run for the eval. My recommendation:
1) Run Hosted PoC to validate feature parity and baseline latency/throughput (2 days).
2) Run Dedicated baseline using the same models but with reserved GPU capacity and our autoscaling off (5 days) to measure 95th pct latency under production-shaped traffic.
3) Security/compliance: complete our SOC 2 folder + provide KMS integration doc; run a short red-team checklist (we can share security-answers.pdf).
4) Cost model: run token-level profiling during both runs and produce a per-1M-token TCO for Hosted vs Dedicated.

Owners: Jonas (overall), Laura (security gating & eval plan), Karthik (pricing & Dedicated sizing), SEs (test harness).

I’ll draft the MAP doc and fold in pricing ranges — target for Jon to send to Horizon tomorrow.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Sara Miles <sara@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, procurement@horizonhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-04T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: MAP draft + proposed eval timeline (Horizon MAP v1)

Sara —

Forwarding internal MAP draft and Laura’s recommendations. Attachment is Horizon_MAP_v1.docx. Highlights and action items below.

Action items for Horizon:
- Confirm procurement lead (copying procurement@)
- Confirm US-only residency & whether test data can be used for the early perf runs
- Approve proposed timeline (Weeks 1–6) or call out mandatory dates

Redwood asks of Horizon:
- Signed MAP (simple acceptance) to unblock week-1 discovery
- Security questionnaire completion within 5 business days of sign
- Data access window for perf runs (we can operate on synthetic data if needed)

Forwarded message:

> Date: 2026-08-03 08:46
> Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & hosting question for Horizon POC (internal recommendations)
>
> Quick internal note to propose what we actually run for the eval...

Let me know what times on Aug 10–12 work for a short working session to lock the MAP.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
attachments: Horizon_MAP_v1.docx

From: procurement@horizonhealth.com
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Sara Miles <sara@horizonhealth.com>
Date: 2026-08-06T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP draft + proposed eval timeline (procurement needs)

Jonas / Sara —

Procurement here. We reviewed the MAP and the proposed cadence. High-level procurement asks:
- Horizon prefers Dedicated with VPC isolation as the target deployment for production due to PHI and our internal policy. Hosted is acceptable for discovery only.
- Please provide a preliminary pricing sheet for Dedicated (monthly reserved) vs Hosted trial and a short SLA summary.
- We need evidence of SOC 2 and a basic KMS/HSM architecture diagram.

Attaching procurement_reqs.pdf with the procurement contact and our standard vendor onboarding checklist. We have a target internal decision meeting on 2026-08-21. Please confirm whether your proposed schedule can land a recommendation to our leadership by then.

—Horizon Procurement
attachments: procurement_reqs.pdf

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: procurement@horizonhealth.com, Sara Miles <sara@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-07T17:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP draft + proposed eval timeline (next steps and pricing ask)

Procurement / Sara —

Thanks — we can accommodate the procurement timeline (decision meeting 2026-08-21). Next steps:
1) Karthik will send a Dedicated vs Hosted pricing sketch and a recommended reserved GPU profile by EOD 2026-08-10.
2) Laura will share the SOC 2 evidence bundle and the KMS integration notes (security-answers.pdf) by EOD 2026-08-09.
3) Jonas to schedule an Aug 11 working session to agree MAP owners and final timeline.

We’ll also include a lightweight DocuSign placeholder for the MAP so procurement can route internally: https://docusign.example.com/MAP-1347.

If Horizon’s preference is Dedicated for production, we’ll treat Hosted as the discovery lane (fast onboarding) and Dedicated as the decision lane (SLA + reserved capacity). Private deployment remains on the table if regulatory/legal finds Dedicated unacceptable — we’ll surface the incremental timeline / effort for that path in Karthik’s note.

Jonas Weber
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
attachments: security-answers.pdf
